passages.title: 科展的特別獎
passages.text: Every year, our school has a science fair, and the winner gets a big {1}. This year, Ken and I wanted to {2} a small car that runs on water. We worked on it every day after school. At first, it didn't move at all, and we didn't {3} why. Then Ken {4} a small hole in the water tank. We fixed it, and the car finally moved! On the day of the fair, the judges asked us many questions. We were nervous, but we {5} all of them. We didn't win first place, but we got a special prize for the best idea. Ken and I high-fived. "Next year," he said, "let's build a car that flies!"

blanks.why: get a prize「得獎、獲得獎品」。answer、notice、weather 放在 a big 後面，和「得到」搭配意思不通。
build a car「打造一台車」。understand、notice、answer a small car 意思不通。
understand why「明白為什麼」：我們不懂為什麼車子不動。build、prepare、grow why 都不通。
notice + 物「注意到、發現」：Ken 發現水箱上有個小洞。prepared、grew、answered a small hole 意思不通。
answer questions「回答問題」：我們回答了所有問題。grew、built、noticed all of them 和「問題」搭配意思不通。

passages.zh: 我們學校每年都有科展，第一名可以得到大獎。今年，Ken 和我想打造一台用水就能跑的小車。我們每天放學後都在做。一開始，車子完全不會動，我們也不懂為什麼。後來 Ken 發現水箱上有個小洞。我們把它補好，車子終於動了！科展那天，評審問了我們很多問題。我們很緊張，但每一題都回答出來了。我們沒有拿到第一名，但得到了最佳創意的特別獎。Ken 和我擊掌。「明年，」他說，「我們來做一台會飛的車！」

passages.title: 院子裡的樹屋
passages.text: When I was ten, Dad and I decided to {1} a treehouse in our backyard. We needed a lot of wood, so we went to the market every weekend to buy it. Dad also drew a plan. He wanted it to be {2}, with a window shaped like a star. Building it was hard work. I hit my finger with a hammer, and Dad almost fell off the ladder once. But slowly, our treehouse got bigger and bigger. Finally, it was finished. From the star window, I could see the whole street {3}. Now I'm fifteen. I don't play in the treehouse much, but I still go up there when I want to think. I finally {4} why Dad worked so hard on it. He wanted to give me a place of my own. One day, I hope to {5} one for my own kids.

blanks.why: build a treehouse「蓋樹屋」。grow、answer、understand a treehouse 意思不通。
want it to be special「希望它很特別」。own 不能單獨當形容詞放在 be 後面；alone、asleep 形容樹屋意思不通。
below 當副詞「在下方」：從窗戶可以看到下面整條街。until、during、than 放句尾都不通。
understand why「明白為什麼」：我終於明白爸爸為什麼那麼用心。prepare、build、grow why 都不通。
build one「蓋一座（樹屋）」。answer、notice、understand one 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我十歲的時候，爸爸和我決定在後院蓋一座樹屋。我們需要很多木頭，所以每個週末都去市場買。爸爸還畫了設計圖，他希望樹屋很特別，有一扇星星形狀的窗戶。蓋樹屋很辛苦，我曾用鐵鎚敲到手指，爸爸也差點從梯子上摔下來。但樹屋慢慢地越來越大，終於完成了。從星星窗戶往外看，可以看到下面整條街。現在我十五歲了，很少在樹屋裡玩，但想事情的時候還是會爬上去。我終於明白爸爸為什麼那麼用心：他想給我一個屬於自己的地方。有一天，我也希望能為我的孩子蓋一座樹屋。

passages.title: 爺爺的西瓜田
passages.text: My grandpa {1} watermelons in southern Taiwan. Every summer {2}, I go to help him. We get up at five to work in the field before it gets too hot. One morning, I {3} that some watermelons had small holes in them. "Who did this?" I asked. Grandpa laughed. "The birds. They know which ones are the sweetest." At the end of summer, Grandpa {4} a big lunch for the workers, and we ate cold watermelon together under a tree. Then he chose the biggest watermelon and gave it to me. "This one is {5}," he said. "You helped it grow."

blanks.why: grow + 植物「種植」：爺爺種西瓜。builds、answers、notices watermelons 意思不通。
summer holiday「暑假」。summer prize、summer answer、summer notice 都不通。
notice that + 句子「注意到…」：我發現有些西瓜上有小洞。built、prepared、grew that 都不通。
prepare lunch「準備午餐」。noticed、answered、understood a big lunch 意思不通。
This one is special.「這顆很特別。」least、likely 不能這樣單獨形容；away 是「離開的」，意思不通。

passages.zh: 我爺爺在台灣南部種西瓜。每年暑假，我都會去幫忙。我們早上五點就起床，趁天氣還不太熱下田工作。有一天早上，我發現有些西瓜上有小洞。「這是誰弄的？」我問。爺爺笑了：「是鳥啦，牠們知道哪幾顆最甜。」暑假快結束時，爺爺為工人們準備了一頓豐盛的午餐，我們在樹下一起吃冰涼的西瓜。接著他挑了最大的一顆送給我。「這顆很特別，」他說，「是你幫忙種大的。」

passages.title: 會手語的新同學
passages.text: A new student named Mei joined our class this year. She can't hear, so she talks with her hands. At first, nobody could {1} her. Our teacher said, "Let's learn sign language together." Every morning, Mei taught us a few words: "hello," "thank you," and "friend." It was hard, but we practiced every day. I {2} that Mei smiled more and more. Two months later, our class performed a song in sign language at the school festival. We {3} for weeks. In the end, our class won a {4} for the best show. After the show, Mei gave me a card. It said, "Thank you for being my friend. You are {5} to me."

blanks.why: understand + 人「聽懂、理解某人」：一開始沒人懂她的意思。build、grow、prepare her 意思不通。
notice that + 句子「注意到…」：我注意到 Mei 笑得越來越多。grew、built、prepared that 都不通。
prepare for weeks「準備了好幾週」，prepare 可以不接受詞。noticed、answered、grew for weeks 意思不通。
win a prize「得獎」。weather、notice、answer 不能和 win 搭配表示得獎。
be special to + 人「對某人來說很特別」。least、likely、asleep 放在這裡意思不通。

passages.zh: 今年我們班來了一位新同學，叫 Mei。她聽不見，所以用手說話。一開始，沒有人看得懂她的意思。老師說：「我們一起來學手語吧。」每天早上，Mei 教我們幾個詞：「你好」、「謝謝」、「朋友」。雖然很難，但我們每天練習。我發現 Mei 笑得越來越多了。兩個月後，我們班在校慶上用手語表演一首歌，我們準備了好幾個星期。最後，我們班得到了最佳表演獎。表演結束後，Mei 給了我一張卡片，上面寫著：「謝謝你當我的朋友。你對我來說很特別。」

passages.title: 阿嬤的電話
passages.text: My grandma lives in Tainan, and she calls me every Sunday night. But last Sunday, I was playing a game and didn't {1} the phone. She called three times. When I finally called her back, she sounded worried. "Are you OK? Why didn't you answer?" I said sorry and told her the truth. She wasn't angry. "I just want to hear your voice," she said. "When you {2} up, you will be busy, and I will be old." Her words made me think. I {3} that our calls were really {4} to her. Now I {5} for our calls. During the week, I write down funny stories from school, so I have lots to tell her on Sunday.

blanks.why: answer the phone「接電話」。build、grow、prepare the phone 意思不通。
grow up「長大」是片語。answer up、build up（意思是「增強」）、notice up 都不是「長大」的意思。
understand that + 句子「明白…」：我明白了我們的通話對她很重要。built、grew、prepared that 都不通。
be special to + 人「對某人很特別」。least、likely、away 放在這裡意思不通。
prepare for + 事情「為…做準備」：現在我會為通話做準備。grow、notice、build for our calls 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我阿嬤住在台南，她每個星期天晚上都會打電話給我。可是上星期天，我在玩遊戲，沒有接電話。她打了三次。等我終於回電，她的聲音聽起來很擔心：「你還好嗎？怎麼沒接電話？」我跟她道歉，說了實話。她沒有生氣。「我只是想聽聽你的聲音，」她說，「等你長大了，就會很忙，我也老了。」她的話讓我想了很多。我明白了，我們的通話對她來說真的很特別。現在我會為我們的通話做準備：平常就把學校的趣事寫下來，星期天就有很多話可以跟她說。

passages.title: 颱風來之前
passages.text: The news said a strong typhoon was coming. "We need to {1}," Dad said. First, we bought water, bread, and noodles. Then Dad put tape on the windows, and I moved the plants inside. My little brother didn't {2} why we were so busy. "Is it a {3}?" he asked, because school was closed the next day. That night, the wind was very loud. Suddenly, the lights went out. My brother was scared, but Dad lit a candle and told us stories. Then I {4} water coming in under the door! We put towels on the floor. In the morning, the typhoon was gone. We looked out the window and saw broken branches on the street {5}.

blanks.why: We need to prepare.「我們要做準備。」prepare 可以不接受詞。notice、grow、answer 放在這裡意思不通。
understand why「明白為什麼」。answer、grow、build why 都不通。
Is it a holiday?「今天放假嗎？」因為隔天停課。prize、notice、answer 意思不通。
notice + 物 + V-ing「注意到…正在…」：我發現水從門下流進來。grew、built、prepared water coming in 都不通。
below 當副詞「在下方」：看到樓下街上的斷枝。until、during、than 放句尾都不通。

passages.zh: 新聞說有個強颱要來了。「我們得做準備。」爸爸說。我們先去買了水、麵包和泡麵。接著爸爸在窗戶上貼膠帶，我把植物搬進屋裡。我弟弟不懂我們為什麼這麼忙。「今天放假嗎？」他問，因為隔天學校停課。那天晚上風聲很大，突然停電了。弟弟很害怕，爸爸點了蠟燭，講故事給我們聽。接著我發現水從門底下流進來了！我們在地上鋪了毛巾。到了早上，颱風走了。我們從窗戶往外看，看到樓下街上滿是斷掉的樹枝。

passages.title: 北海道的雪人
passages.text: This winter {1}, my family went to Hokkaido in Japan. It was my first time to see snow! Everything was white. My sister and I wanted to {2} a snowman. We worked for an hour, but our snowman looked like a potato. A Japanese boy came over and helped us. He didn't speak English, and we didn't speak Japanese, but we could {3} each other with our hands and smiles. When the snowman was finished, the boy gave us a {4} gift: a small toy fox. "Kitsune," he said. That means "fox" in Japanese. That night, we stayed in a hotel on a hill. From our window, we could see the lights of the city {5}. Now the toy fox sits on my desk, and it always reminds me of my new friend.

blanks.why: winter holiday「寒假」。winter prize、winter answer、winter notice 都不通。
build a snowman「堆雪人」。answer、understand、notice a snowman 意思不通。
understand each other「互相理解」：比手畫腳也能懂彼此。grow、build、prepare each other 意思不通。
a special gift「一份特別的禮物」。least、likely 不能這樣形容名詞；alone 只能放在 be 動詞後面，不能放在名詞前。
the city below「下方的城市」，below 放在名詞後面表示位置。until、during、than 放在這裡都不通。

passages.zh: 今年寒假，我們全家去了日本北海道。那是我第一次看到雪！到處都是白色的。我和妹妹想堆一個雪人，弄了一個小時，雪人看起來卻像一顆馬鈴薯。一個日本男孩走過來幫我們。他不會說英文，我們也不會說日文，但靠著比手畫腳和微笑，我們還是懂彼此的意思。雪人完成後，男孩送我們一份特別的禮物：一隻小狐狸玩偶。「Kitsune。」他說，那是日文的「狐狸」。那天晚上，我們住在山丘上的旅館，從窗戶可以看到山下城市的燈光。現在小狐狸就坐在我的書桌上，總是讓我想起我的新朋友。

passages.title: 電梯裡的告示
passages.text: One morning, Mom saw a {1} in the elevator of our building. It said, "Water will be off tomorrow from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m." Mom told us to {2} some water. So we filled the bathtub and lots of bottles. The next day, the water went off. Mr. Lin, our neighbor who lives on the floor {3} us, knocked on our door. "I didn't {4} the sign," he said. "Now I have no water to cook with." Mom gave him three big bottles of water. That evening, he came back with a plate of dumplings. "Thank you," he said. "You saved my dinner." Now I {5} why it's good to know your neighbors.

blanks.why: notice 當名詞「告示、公告」：電梯裡有一張公告。prize、holiday、answer 都不會貼在電梯裡說明停水。
prepare some water「準備一些水」。grow、build、notice some water 意思不通。
the floor below us「我們樓下那一層」，below 表示「在…下方」。until、during、than 接 us 意思不通。
notice the sign「注意到告示」。build、grow、prepare the sign 意思不通。
understand why「明白為什麼」：現在我明白認識鄰居的好處了。build、grow、prepare why 都不通。

passages.zh: 有一天早上，媽媽在我們大樓的電梯裡看到一張公告，上面寫著：「明天上午九點到下午五點停水。」媽媽要我們準備一些水，所以我們把浴缸和很多瓶子都裝滿了。隔天果然停水了。住在我們樓下的鄰居林先生來敲我們家的門。「我沒注意到那張公告，」他說，「現在沒有水可以煮飯了。」媽媽給了他三大瓶水。那天傍晚，他端著一盤水餃回來。「謝謝你們，」他說，「你們救了我的晚餐。」現在我明白了，認識鄰居真的很重要。

passages.title: 外星人愛上臭豆腐
passages.text: An alien named Zork came to Earth to learn about our food. He visited a night market in Taipei and saw many {1} snacks. He tried stinky tofu first. He didn't {2} why people liked something that smelled so bad. But when he tasted it, he loved it! He wanted to learn how to {3} it himself. The shop owner, Mrs. Chen, agreed to teach him. Zork {4} that she put a secret sauce on the tofu. "What is in it?" he asked. Mrs. Chen just smiled and didn't {5}. Zork went back to his planet and opened a stinky tofu shop. It is now the most popular shop in space, but the sauce is still a secret.

blanks.why: special snacks「特別的小吃」。asleep、alone、afraid 只能放在 be 動詞後面，不能放在名詞前，意思也不通。
understand why「明白為什麼」。build、grow、notice why 都不通。
prepare + 食物「烹調、準備食物」：他想學怎麼自己做臭豆腐。notice、answer、grow it 意思不通。
notice that + 句子「注意到…」。built、grew、answered that 都不通。
didn't answer「沒有回答」，answer 可以不接受詞。build、grow、notice 放在這裡意思不通。

passages.zh: 一個叫 Zork 的外星人來到地球研究我們的食物。他逛了台北的夜市，看到許多特別的小吃。他先試了臭豆腐。他不明白為什麼大家會喜歡聞起來那麼臭的東西，但一吃下去，他就愛上了！他想學怎麼自己做。老闆娘陳太太答應教他。Zork 注意到她在豆腐上淋了一種祕密醬汁。「裡面加了什麼？」他問。陳太太只是笑笑，沒有回答。Zork 回到自己的星球，開了一家臭豆腐店。現在它是全宇宙最受歡迎的店，但醬汁依然是個祕密。

passages.title: 抽中腳踏車
passages.text: Every year, our neighborhood has a party before the New Year {1}. There is always a lucky draw, and the first {2} is a new bike. This year, I really wanted it. When they called the numbers, I listened carefully. "Number 86!" That was me! I couldn't believe it. But then I {3} an old man looking at the bike sadly. I found out that he needed a bike to go to the market, because he couldn't walk far. I talked to my parents, and they {4}. So I gave the bike to him. He held my hand and said, "You will {5} up to be a kind man." Last week, I saw him riding the bike to the market, and he waved at me.

blanks.why: the New Year holiday「新年假期」。prize、answer、notice 放在 New Year 後面意思不通。
the first prize「頭獎」。first holiday、first answer、first notice 都不是「頭獎」。
notice + 人 + V-ing「注意到某人正在…」：我注意到一位老先生難過地看著腳踏車。grew、built、prepared 都不能這樣用。
understand 可以不接受詞「能體諒、理解」：爸媽也能理解。grew、built、happened 放在這裡意思不通。
grow up to be …「長大成為…」。build、answer、prepare up 都不能表示「長大」。

passages.zh: 每年新年假期前，我們社區都會辦派對，也一定會有抽獎，頭獎是一台新腳踏車。今年我非常想要它。唸號碼的時候，我仔細聽著。「86 號！」是我！我簡直不敢相信。可是接著我注意到一位老爺爺難過地看著那台腳踏車。我後來知道，他走不了遠路，需要腳踏車去市場。我跟爸媽說了，他們也能理解。所以我把腳踏車送給了他。他握著我的手說：「你長大一定會是個善良的人。」上星期，我看到他騎著那台腳踏車去市場，還對我揮了揮手。
